Request budget: the handoff says 'a few hundred requests at most'. The run made 935 browser requests (about 25 never left the browser) and 38 curl requests. A page load is 14 requests because every file revalidates (Cache-Control max-age=0, must-revalidate), so the 12-cell matrix of four pages and the demo alone cost about 400. It was one Chrome at a time, about one request a second, static files and the two demo calls only; nothing was broken. ORCH should know the number; the scenarios that still ran in fewer cells than their files name are listed in the record. If the owner wants a thinner or a fuller run next time, the budget or the matrix should be set in the task.
